Fulham vs Newcastle United. Premier League.

Fulham 1-1 Newcastle: Rodrigo Muniz rescues point for hosts after Jacob Murphy's stunner at Craven Cottage
Report and free match highlights as Rodrigo Muniz snatches point for Fulham after Jacob Murphy's stunner gave Newcastle lead at Craven Cottage, in first ever Premier League draw between the two in London
Saturday 7 November 2026 17:51, UK
Rodrigo Muniz's unorthodox equaliser denied Matthias Jaissle a pressure-relieving victory but his Newcastle side were still much improved in a deserved 1-1 draw at Fulham.
The heat had began to ramp up on the German boss after the Magpies were booed off at the end of a limp home defeat to Everton on Monday night but a chalk-and-cheese showing in west London lacked only the three points in a game they arguably shaded.

Newcastle thought they had earned a first-half lead when Dan Burn nodded home from a corner but his celebrations in front of his old fans were cut short with Yoane Wissa penalised for a shirt pull on Timothy Castagne.
There should have been no need for the VAR had Harvey Barnes buried his chance when played in behind moments earlier, but aimed hisfinish too close to Bernd Leno when clean through.
The best Fulham could muster, despite their territorial dominance, was a Josh King volley and a glancing header from their internationally-recognised teenager, as their recent struggles in front of goal continued.
The game appeared to be drifting towards a first draw between these two in 19 Premier League meetings in the capital, until a loose pass from Cesar Palacios across midfield allowed Murphy to run at Antonee Robinson before turning inside and unleashing an unstoppable effort beyond Leno.
The relief in Jaissle's celebration was evident but was only a brief respite with Fulham's messy equaliser coming only three minutes later, as Palacios' pass deflected into the path of Muniz and his inventive flick beat Lukas Hornicek with some help from Burn.
It was his first Premier League goal in seven months but came at the perfect time to rescue a point for the hosts, and deny Jaissle a win he would have found so personally valuable.
The key moments from Craven Cottage
13: SAVE! Oscar Bobb's curling effort is turned away by Lukas Hornicek.
14: OVER! Gonzalo Garcia nods over at the back post from a corner.
32: BIG CHANCE! Barnes has to bury the ball when played in behind but shoots straight at Leno.
33: NO GOAL! Burn has the ball in the Fulham net from the resulting corner but is denied a goal by Wissa's pull on Castagne.
37: SAVE! King catches a volley sweetly from 20 yards but is denied by a comfortable Hornicek save.
80: GOAL! Murphy makes the most of Berge's loose pass after racing forward and unleashing a stunning curling effort into the far corner.
83: GOAL! Muniz turns home an instant equaliser with the outside of his boot after Palacios' pass deflects into his path.
90+2: SAVE! Hornicek denies Ryan Sessegnon's late half-volley with a flying stop.

ניוקאסל יונייטד הייתה קרובה להשיג ניצחון חוץ משמעותי תחת המאמן מתיאס יאיסלה, אך נאלצה להסתפק בתיקו 1-1 מול פולהאם באצטדיון קרייבן קוטג'. האורחים הפגינו יכולת משופרת משמעותית בהשוואה למשחקיהם הקודמים, ואף כבשו במחצית הראשונה משער של דן ברן, אך השער נפסל בצדק עקב עבירה של יואן ויסה.

המחצית השנייה התאפיינה בקצב גבוה, כאשר ג'ייקוב מרפי העלה את ניוקאסל ליתרון בדקה ה-80 עם בעיטה מרהיבה מרחוק. אלא שפולהאם לא ויתרה, וכעבור שלוש דקות בלבד ניצל רודריגו מוניז מסירה נגוחה ומקרית כדי להשוות את התוצאה עם בעיטה מדויקת. התיקו מונע מיאיסלה את האפשרות להקל על הלחץ המופעל עליו, בעוד המארחות שומרות על נקודה יקרה בביתן.
